def write_pad_bar(g, pat, bar, chord_name, vol=34):
    b = bar * 32
    _, _, _, triad = CHORDS[chord_name]
    m0, m1, m2 = [note_to_midi(x) for x in triad]
    g.set(pat, b, CH_PAD1, note=m0, inst=I_PAD, vol=vol)
    g.set(pat, b, CH_PAD2, note=m2, inst=I_PAD, vol=vol)
    # Subtle harmonic voice motion at bar midpoint
    g.set(pat, b + 16, CH_PAD2, note=m1 + 12, inst=I_PAD, vol=max(20, vol - 4))

def write_lead_phrase(g, pat, events, ch=CH_LEAD, echo_ch=CH_ECHO1, inst=I_LEAD,
                      base_vol=58, echo_delay=6, echo_ratio=0.45, vib=True):
    """
    events: list of (row, note_str_or_midi, dur_rows, slide_porta_speed_or_0)
    Automatically inserts OFF at end of sustained notes if next event isn't immediate,
    adds tasteful vibrato on held notes >= 6 rows, and builds stereo tracker echo!
    """
    for idx, ev in enumerate(events):
        row, n, dur = ev[0], ev[1], ev[2]
        porta = ev[3] if len(ev) > 3 else 0
        vol = ev[4] if len(ev) > 4 else base_vol
        m = note_to_midi(n)

        if porta > 0:
            g.set(pat, row, ch, note=m, vol=vol, fx=0x03, param=porta)
        else:
            g.set(pat, row, ch, note=m, inst=inst, vol=vol)

        # Add expressive vibrato on notes held >= 6 rows
        if vib and dur >= 6:
            vib_start = row + 2
            for vr in range(vib_start, min(128, row + dur)):
                if (pat, vr, ch) not in g.cells:
                    g.set(pat, vr, ch, fx=0x04, param=0x45)

        # Clean note-off if there's a gap before next event (or at end of phrase)
        next_row = events[idx + 1][0] if idx + 1 < len(events) else 999
        if row + dur < next_row and row + dur < 128:
            g.off(pat, row + dur, ch)

        # Stereo tracker echo!
        if echo_ch is not None:
            er = row + echo_delay
            if er < 128:
                ev_vol = max(12, int(vol * echo_ratio))
                g.set(pat, er, echo_ch, note=m, inst=inst, vol=ev_vol)
                end_er = min(127, er + min(dur, 6))
                next_er = (events[idx + 1][0] + echo_delay) if idx + 1 < len(events) else 999
                if end_er < next_er and end_er < 128:
                    g.off(pat, end_er, echo_ch)

import wave, os, json, subprocess, numpy as np

def inspect_wav(path):
    with wave.open(path, 'rb') as w:
        sr = w.getframerate()
        nch = w.getnchannels()
        nf = w.getnframes()
        raw = w.readframes(nf)
    audio = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype='<i2').reshape(-1, nch).astype(np.float64)
    dur = nf / sr
    pk_l, pk_r = np.max(np.abs(audio[:,0])), np.max(np.abs(audio[:,1]))
    clip_l = np.sum(np.abs(audio[:,0]) >= 32766)
    clip_r = np.sum(np.abs(audio[:,1]) >= 32766)
    rms_l = np.sqrt(np.mean(audio[:,0]**2))
    rms_r = np.sqrt(np.mean(audio[:,1]**2))
    dc_l, dc_r = np.mean(audio[:,0]), np.mean(audio[:,1])
    corr = np.corrcoef(audio[:,0], audio[:,1])[0,1]
    print(f"=== GLOBAL STATS ({path}) ===")
    print(f"Duration: {dur:.3f}s ({nf} frames @ {sr} Hz)")
    print(f"Peak L/R: {pk_l:.0f} / {pk_r:.0f}  ({20*np.log10(max(pk_l,pk_r)/32767):.2f} dBFS)")
    print(f"Clipped samples (>=32766): L={clip_l}, R={clip_r}")
    print(f"RMS  L/R: {rms_l:.1f} / {rms_r:.1f}  (Crest: {20*np.log10(max(pk_l,pk_r)/max(rms_l,rms_r)):.2f} dB)")
    print(f"DC   L/R: {dc_l:+.2f} / {dc_r:+.2f} | Stereo Corr: {corr:.3f}")

    # Per-pattern breakdown (15 patterns)
    pat_len = nf / 15.0
    print("\n=== PER-PATTERN BREAKDOWN ===")
    print(f"{'Pat':>3s} {'Time':>7s} {'Peak':>6s} {'RMS_L':>7s} {'RMS_R':>7s} {'Corr':>6s} {'Low%':>6s} {'Mid%':>6s} {'Hi%':>6s} {'Clip':>5s}")
    for p in range(15):
        s0 = int(round(p * pat_len))
        s1 = int(round((p + 1) * pat_len))
        seg = audio[s0:s1]
        pk = np.max(np.abs(seg))
        rl = np.sqrt(np.mean(seg[:,0]**2))
        rr = np.sqrt(np.mean(seg[:,1]**2))
        c = np.corrcoef(seg[:,0], seg[:,1])[0,1]
        cl = np.sum(np.abs(seg) >= 32766)
        mono = 0.5 * (seg[:,0] + seg[:,1])
        mono -= np.mean(mono)
        fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(mono * np.hanning(len(mono))))**2
        freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(mono), 1.0/sr)
        tot_e = max(np.sum(fft), 1.0)
        low_e = np.sum(fft[freqs < 200]) / tot_e * 100
        mid_e = np.sum(fft[(freqs >= 200) & (freqs < 2500)]) / tot_e * 100
        hi_e  = np.sum(fft[freqs >= 2500]) / tot_e * 100
        print(f"{p:3d} {s0/sr:6.1f}s {pk:6.0f} {rl:7.1f} {rr:7.1f} {c:6.3f} {low_e:5.1f}% {mid_e:5.1f}% {hi_e:5.1f}% {cl:5d}")

    # Check consecutive 10ms RMS windows for any sudden clicks/dropouts
    hop = int(sr * 0.010)
    mono = 0.5 * (audio[:,0] + audio[:,1])
    # Check max single-sample step jump across entire song
    diffs = np.abs(np.diff(audio, axis=0))
    max_step = np.max(diffs)
    p999_step = np.percentile(diffs, 99.9)
    print(f"\nMax sample-to-sample jump: {max_step:.0f} (99.9th pct: {p999_step:.0f})")

def check_loop_seam(xm_path):
    # Render [order 14 -> order 1] by saving a temp copy or rendering via ft2
    # Actually let's load xm_path, set order 0=14, order 1=1, length=2, render, then reload original!
    subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'module_load', json.dumps({'path': xm_path})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'order_set', json.dumps({'position': 0, 'pattern': 14})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'order_set', json.dumps({'position': 1, 'pattern': 1})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'song_set', json.dumps({'length': 2, 'loop_start': 0})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

    subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'module_load', json.dumps({'path': xm_path})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

    with wave.open('/tmp/keygen/seam.wav', 'rb') as w:
        sr = w.getframerate()
        nf = w.getnframes()
        seam = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(nf), dtype='<i2').reshape(-1, 2).astype(np.float64)
    mid = nf // 2
    pre = seam[mid - 2000 : mid]
    post = seam[mid : mid + 2000]
    jump_at_seam = np.max(np.abs(seam[mid] - seam[mid - 1]))
    max_jump_near = np.max(np.abs(np.diff(seam[mid-100:mid+100], axis=0)))
    print(f"\n=== LOOP SEAM CHECK (Pat 14 -> Pat 1 at sample {mid}) ===")
    print(f"Pre-seam RMS (last 45ms): {np.sqrt(np.mean(pre**2)):.1f} | Post-seam RMS (first 45ms): {np.sqrt(np.mean(post**2)):.1f}")
    print(f"Exact seam step jump: {jump_at_seam:.0f} (local max step: {max_jump_near:.0f})")
    print(f"Seam window peak: {np.max(np.abs(seam[mid-4000:mid+4000])):.0f}, clipped: {np.sum(np.abs(seam) >= 32766)}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    inspect_wav('/tmp/keygen/preview.wav')
    check_loop_seam('/workspace/submission/tune.xm')
    print("\nXM file size:", os.path.getsize('/workspace/submission/tune.xm'), "bytes")

import numpy as np

SR = 33452  # 8363 * 4 -> relative_note = 24 plays 1:1 at C-4 (261.34 Hz, 128 samples/cycle)
C4_HZ = SR / 128.0  # 261.34375 Hz

def remove_dc_and_taper(x, fade_in_ms=2.0, fade_out_ms=5.0, fade_out=True):
    x = x.astype(np.float64)
    x -= np.mean(x)
    n_in = min(len(x) // 4, int(SR * fade_in_ms / 1000.0))
    if n_in > 1:
        u = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_in)
        x[:n_in] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    if fade_out:
        n_out = min(len(x) // 2, int(SR * fade_out_ms / 1000.0))
        if n_out > 1:
            u = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, n_out)
            x[-n_out:] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    return x

def to_int16_pcm(x, peak=26000):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if m > 1e-12:
        x = x * (peak / m)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes()

def one_pole_hp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = rc / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_x = 0.0
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        cur = alpha * (prev_y + x[i] - prev_x)
        y[i] = cur
        prev_x = x[i]
        prev_y = cur
    return y

def one_pole_lp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = dt / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        prev_y = prev_y + alpha * (x[i] - prev_y)
        y[i] = prev_y
    return y

def make_kick():
    # Punchy tight 190ms kick: 205 -> 50 Hz sweep + crisp transient click
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_start, f_end, tau_f = 205.0, 50.0, 0.026
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau_f * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau_f)))
    body = np.sin(phase) * 0.92 + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.020)
    amp = np.exp(-t / 0.062)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
    click_noise = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 1800.0), 9000.0)
    click = (click_noise * 0.30 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1750 * t) * 0.38) * np.exp(-t / 0.0028)
    sig = np.tanh((body * amp + click) * 1.45)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 36.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.0, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Kick_Punch", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26000),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_snare():
    # Crisp snappy snare: 225 -> 135 Hz body + smooth bandlimited wires
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (135.0 * t + 95.0 * 0.022 * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.022)))
    body = (np.sin(phase) + 0.28 * np.sin(1.85 * phase)) * np.exp(-t / 0.042)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(202)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 10500.0)
    wires_hi = one_pole_hp(noise, 1800.0)
    wires_snap = one_pole_hp(noise, 3600.0)
    wires = wires_hi * np.exp(-t / 0.065) * 0.78 + wires_snap * np.exp(-t / 0.020) * 0.65
    sig = np.tanh((body * 0.72 + wires * 0.90) * 1.30)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 100.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=0.8, fade_out_ms=30.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Snare_Crisp", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26000),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 122, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _metallic_hat(dur, decay_tau, seed):
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [317.0, 463.0, 619.0, 811.0, 1021.0, 1289.0]
    metal = np.zeros(n)
    for f in freqs:
        w = 2.0 * np.pi * f * t
        metal += np.sin(w) + 0.33 * np.sin(3 * w) + 0.2 * np.sin(5 * w)
    metal = one_pole_hp(metal / len(freqs), 4800.0)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    air = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 6200.0), 12500.0)
    sig = (metal * 0.65 + air * 0.95) * np.exp(-t / decay_tau)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.0, fade_out_ms=min(40.0, dur * 300.0), fade_out=True)
    return sig

def make_hat_closed():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.065, 0.015, 303)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Closed", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 158, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_hat_open():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.30, 0.090, 404)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Open", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 50, "panning": 158, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_crash():
    dur = 0.90
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    rng = np.random.default_rng(505)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 12000.0)
    shimmer = one_pole_hp(noise, 3400.0)
    ring = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) for f in [523.0, 787.0, 1171.0, 1693.0, 2341.0]) / 5.0
    ring = one_pole_hp(ring, 2800.0)
    env = (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.004)) * np.exp(-t / 0.25)
    sig = (shimmer * 0.85 + ring * 0.35) * env
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=3.0, fade_out_ms=120.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Crash_Shimmer", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 98, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_chip_tom():
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_end = C4_HZ * 0.5
    f_start = f_end * 1.95
    tau = 0.032
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau)))
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) - 0.10 * np.sin(3.0 * phase)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(606)
    snap = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 1500.0), 9000.0) * np.exp(-t / 0.006) * 0.35
    sig = body * np.exp(-t / 0.065) + snap
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 55.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.2, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Chip_Tom", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 23000),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 98, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _additive_sweep_loop(n_attack_cycles, n_loop_cycles, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_amp_fn, res_fn=None, detune_cents=0.0, max_h=20):
    cyc = 128
    n_atk = n_attack_cycles * cyc
    n_lp = n_loop_cycles * cyc
    n_tot = n_atk + n_lp
    idx = np.arange(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)
    t_sec = idx / SR

    t_env = np.minimum(t_sec, n_atk / SR)
    amp_env = amp_fn(t_env)
    cutoff_h = cutoff_fn(t_env)
    res_amt = res_fn(t_env) if res_fn is not None else np.zeros_like(t_env)

    sig = np.zeros(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)

    if detune_cents == 0.0:
        for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
            a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
            if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                continue
            # Raised-cosine Lanczos window eliminates Gibbs cliffs & prevents high-note aliasing
            taper = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (h - 1) / float(max_h)) ** 0.7
            lpf = 1.0 / (1.0 + (h / np.maximum(cutoff_h, 1.0)) ** 4)
            res_bump = res_amt * np.exp(-0.5 * ((h - cutoff_h) / 1.1) ** 2)
            gain = a_h * taper * (lpf + res_bump)
            sig += gain * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * h * idx / cyc)
    else:
        k_off = max(1, round(n_loop_cycles * (2.0 ** (detune_cents / 1200.0) - 1.0)))
        osc_cycles = [n_loop_cycles - k_off, n_loop_cycles, n_loop_cycles + k_off]
        osc_weights = [0.50, 0.95, 0.50]
        for oc, ow in zip(osc_cycles, osc_weights):
            freq_ratio = oc / float(n_lp)
            for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
                a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
                if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                    continue
                taper = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (h - 1) / float(max_h)) ** 0.7
                lpf = 1.0 / (1.0 + (h / np.maximum(cutoff_h, 1.0)) ** 4)
                sig += ow * a_h * taper * lpf * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * h * freq_ratio * idx)

    sig *= amp_env
    # Smooth 4ms raised-cosine fade-in at start
    n_in = min(n_atk // 2, int(SR * 0.004))
    if n_in > 1:
        u = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_in)
        sig[:n_in] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    return sig, n_atk, n_lp

def make_bass_octave():
    # Punchy octave chip/analog bass: bright snap -> warm sub+mid loop
    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 36, 1
    def amp_fn(t):
        return 0.45 + 0.55 * np.exp(-t / 0.045)
    def cutoff_fn(t):
        return 4.5 + 12.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.032)
    def harm_fn(h):
        saw = ((-1)**(h+1)) / h
        sq = (1.0 / h) if (h % 2 == 1) else 0.0
        return 0.65 * saw + 0.35 * sq
    sig, n_atk, n_lp = _additive_sweep_loop(n_atk_c, n_lp_c, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_fn, max_h=18)
    return {
        "name": "Bass_Octave", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

def make_bass_acid():
    # Squelchy resonant filter-swept 303 bass for Section D solo
    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 48, 1
    def amp_fn(t):
        return 0.44 + 0.56 * np.exp(-t / 0.068)
    def cutoff_fn(t):
        return 3.0 + 13.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.052)
    def res_fn(t):
        return 1.35 * np.exp(-t / 0.105)
    def harm_fn(h):
        return ((-1)**(h+1)) / h
    sig, n_atk, n_lp = _additive_sweep_loop(n_atk_c, n_lp_c, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_fn, res_fn=res_fn, max_h=18)

        "name": "Bass_Acid303", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),

        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

    def fn(h):
        return (2.0 / (np.pi * h)) * np.sin(np.pi * h * duty)
    return fn

    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 16, 1
    def amp_fn(t):
        return 0.56 + 0.44 * np.exp(-t / 0.022)
    def cutoff_fn(t):
        return 8.5 + 7.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.018)
    sig, n_atk, n_lp = _additive_sweep_loop(n_atk_c, n_lp_c, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, _pulse_harm(0.25), max_h=16)

        "name": "Chip_Arp25", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 21000),

        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

    def amp_fn(t):
        return 0.52 + 0.48 * np.exp(-t / 0.032)

        return 10.0 + 7.0 * np.exp(-t / 0.028)

        "name": "Lead_HeroPWM", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 27000),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 114, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

def make_lead_pluck_bell():
    dur = 0.85
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f0 = C4_HZ
    mod_idx = 2.4 * np.exp(-t / 0.065) + 0.12 * np.exp(-t / 0.30)
    mod = mod_idx * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (2.0 * f0) * t) + 0.25 * mod_idx * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (3.0 * f0) * t)

    return {

        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_pad_warm_chorus():
    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 32, 192
    def amp_fn(t):
        return 1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.032)
    def cutoff_fn(t):
        return np.full_like(t, 4.5)
    def harm_fn(h):

    sig, n_atk, n_lp = _additive_sweep_loop(n_atk_c, n_lp_c, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_fn, detune_cents=12.0, max_h=12)

        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

    dur = 0.16
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_start, f_end, tau = 1800.0, 130.0, 0.045
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau)))
    sig = (np.sin(phase) + 0.30 * np.sin(3.0 * phase) * 0.5) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=2.0, fade_out_ms=20.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "FX_ChipLaser", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 21000),
        "volume": 46, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_fx_noise_riser():
    dur = 1.60
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    rng = np.random.default_rng(707)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 11500.0)
    y_bp = np.zeros(n)
    lp = 0.0
    bp = 0.0
    q_inv = 0.22
    u = t / dur
    cutoffs = 320.0 * (18.0 ** u)
    for i in range(n):
        f = 2.0 * np.sin(np.pi * min(cutoffs[i], SR * 0.42) / SR)

        y_bp[i] = bp
    env = (u ** 1.7) * np.sin(np.pi * np.minimum(1.0, (1.0 - u) * 18.0) * 0.5)
    sig = y_bp * env
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=25.0, fade_out_ms=15.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "FX_NoiseRiser", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 46, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def build_all_instruments():
    makers = [
        make_kick,            # 1
        make_snare,           # 2
        make_hat_closed,      # 3
        make_hat_open,        # 4
        make_crash,           # 5
        make_chip_tom,        # 6
        make_bass_octave,     # 7
        make_bass_acid,       # 8
        make_chip_arp25,      # 9  (pan=74 L)

        make_pad_warm_chorus, # 13
        make_stab_chord_chip, # 14 (pan=154 R)
        make_fx_laser,        # 15
        make_fx_noise_riser,  # 16
        lambda: make_chip_pulse12(pan=66, name="Chip_Counter12", vol=44), # 17 (pan=66 L)
    ]
    return [(i + 1, fn()) for i, fn in enumerate(makers)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for idx, d in build_all_instruments():
        arr = np.frombuffer(d['pcm'], dtype='<i2').astype(float)
        diffs = np.abs(np.diff(arr))
        mx = np.max(diffs)
        mi = np.argmax(diffs)
        print(f"Inst {idx:2d} {d['name']:15s}: pan={d['panning']:3d}, max_diff={mx:6.0f} at {mi}")

messages.reasoning_content:
**A Moment of Signal Processing Brilliance!**

Okay, so I was digging through the output and BAM! Right there at the bottom, I saw it: huge internal differences, single-sample jumps, and I immediately recognized a potential signal processing issue.

First, those additive synthesis instruments (`Bass_Octave`, `Bass_Acid303`, `Lead_HeroPWM`, `Stab_ChordChip`) were exhibiting massive one-sample drops at the half-cycle point (`idx = 64`). Turns out, that's the telltale sign of a sawtooth wave's Gibbs phenomenon – the *steep* discontinuous edge causing those huge sample differences. And that's happening because, when pitching those instruments up, the high harmonics were way over Nyquist and not being handled gracefully. So the fix? Apply a spectral rolloff like cosine or Lanczos filter to tame that Gibbs overshoot and use a 4ms fade-in, a good start value for `cutoff_h` around 14–16 harmonics, making it smooth even when pitched up.

Then, there was `Snare_Crisp`. A huge jump in a single sample! Looking deeper, it's the high-passed noise that's going wild. I was using a tanh on high-passed white noise with no band-limiting. This means that unconstrained white noise, even after high-passing, can still ping-pong between extremes at Nyquist – which sounds really harsh. So I need to add a gentle band-limit above, say, 12kHz, to the noise to smooth things out.

I also need to shift the spectral balance:
Low (<200 Hz): 40-48%
Mid (200-2500 Hz): 42-50%
Hi (>2500 Hz): 8-14%

To that end, dial back the sub-heavy `Kick` and `Bass`, and boost the presence of `Hat_Closed`, `Hat_Open`, `Snare_Crisp`, and `Lead_HeroPWM`!

And finally, it's time to nail down the stereo panning! After looking through the code for a while, I need to add `I_CNT` and `CH_CNT` (Inst 17) to make sure things are locked in where I want them. So I'm making a new counter-lead with the new panning and updating the stereo panning. From there, I need to make a couple of updates, for instance on `CH_ECHO1` to make sure it is in stereo correctly!

It's time to update and listen back!

import numpy as np

SR = 33452  # 8363 * 4 -> relative_note = 24 plays 1:1 at C-4 (261.34 Hz, 128 samples/cycle)
C4_HZ = SR / 128.0  # 261.34375 Hz

def remove_dc_and_taper(x, fade_in_ms=2.0, fade_out_ms=5.0, fade_out=True):
    x = x.astype(np.float64)
    x -= np.mean(x)
    n_in = min(len(x) // 4, int(SR * fade_in_ms / 1000.0))
    if n_in > 1:
        u = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_in)
        x[:n_in] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    if fade_out:
        n_out = min(len(x) // 2, int(SR * fade_out_ms / 1000.0))
        if n_out > 1:
            u = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, n_out)
            x[-n_out:] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    return x

def to_int16_pcm(x, peak=26000):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if m > 1e-12:
        x = x * (peak / m)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes()

def one_pole_hp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = rc / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_x = 0.0
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        cur = alpha * (prev_y + x[i] - prev_x)
        y[i] = cur
        prev_x = x[i]
        prev_y = cur
    return y

def one_pole_lp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = dt / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        prev_y = prev_y + alpha * (x[i] - prev_y)
        y[i] = prev_y
    return y

def make_kick():
    # Punchy tight 190ms kick: 205 -> 50 Hz sweep + crisp transient click
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_start, f_end, tau_f = 205.0, 50.0, 0.026
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau_f * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau_f)))
    body = np.sin(phase) * 0.92 + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.020)
    amp = np.exp(-t / 0.062)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
    click_noise = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 1800.0), 9000.0)
    click = (click_noise * 0.30 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1750 * t) * 0.38) * np.exp(-t / 0.0028)
    sig = np.tanh((body * amp + click) * 1.45)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 36.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.0, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Kick_Punch", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26000),
        "volume": 58, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_snare():
    # Crisp snappy snare: 225 -> 135 Hz body + smooth bandlimited wires
    dur = 0.20
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (135.0 * t + 95.0 * 0.022 * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.022)))
    body = (np.sin(phase) + 0.28 * np.sin(1.85 * phase)) * np.exp(-t / 0.042)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(202)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 10500.0)
    wires_hi = one_pole_hp(noise, 1800.0)
    wires_snap = one_pole_hp(noise, 3600.0)
    wires = wires_hi * np.exp(-t / 0.065) * 0.78 + wires_snap * np.exp(-t / 0.020) * 0.65
    sig = np.tanh((body * 0.72 + wires * 0.90) * 1.30)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 100.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=0.8, fade_out_ms=30.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Snare_Crisp", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26000),
        "volume": 62, "panning": 122, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _metallic_hat(dur, decay_tau, seed):
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [317.0, 463.0, 619.0, 811.0, 1021.0, 1289.0]
    metal = np.zeros(n)
    for f in freqs:
        w = 2.0 * np.pi * f * t
        metal += np.sin(w) + 0.33 * np.sin(3 * w) + 0.2 * np.sin(5 * w)
    metal = one_pole_hp(metal / len(freqs), 4800.0)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    air = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 6200.0), 12500.0)
    sig = (metal * 0.65 + air * 0.95) * np.exp(-t / decay_tau)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.0, fade_out_ms=min(40.0, dur * 300.0), fade_out=True)
    return sig

def make_hat_closed():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.065, 0.015, 303)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Closed", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 158, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_hat_open():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.30, 0.090, 404)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Open", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 50, "panning": 158, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_crash():
    dur = 0.90
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    rng = np.random.default_rng(505)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 12000.0)
    shimmer = one_pole_hp(noise, 3400.0)
    ring = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) for f in [523.0, 787.0, 1171.0, 1693.0, 2341.0]) / 5.0
    ring = one_pole_hp(ring, 2800.0)
    env = (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.004)) * np.exp(-t / 0.25)
    sig = (shimmer * 0.85 + ring * 0.35) * env
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=3.0, fade_out_ms=120.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Crash_Shimmer", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 98, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_chip_tom():
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_end = C4_HZ * 0.5
    f_start = f_end * 1.95
    tau = 0.032
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau)))
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) - 0.10 * np.sin(3.0 * phase)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(606)
    snap = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 1500.0), 9000.0) * np.exp(-t / 0.006) * 0.35
    sig = body * np.exp(-t / 0.065) + snap
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 55.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.2, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Chip_Tom", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 23000),
        "volume": 54, "panning": 98, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _additive_sweep_loop(n_attack_cycles, n_loop_cycles, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_amp_fn, res_fn=None, detune_cents=0.0, max_h=20):
    cyc = 128
    n_atk = n_attack_cycles * cyc
    n_lp = n_loop_cycles * cyc
    n_tot = n_atk + n_lp
    idx = np.arange(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)
    t_sec = idx / SR

    t_env = np.minimum(t_sec, n_atk / SR)
    amp_env = amp_fn(t_env)
    cutoff_h = cutoff_fn(t_env)
    res_amt = res_fn(t_env) if res_fn is not None else np.zeros_like(t_env)

    sig = np.zeros(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)

    if detune_cents == 0.0:
        for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
            a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
            if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                continue
            # Raised-cosine Lanczos window eliminates Gibbs cliffs & prevents high-note aliasing
            taper = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (h - 1) / float(max_h)) ** 0.7
            lpf = 1.0 / (1.0 + (h / np.maximum(cutoff_h, 1.0)) ** 4)
            res_bump = res_amt * np.exp(-0.5 * ((h - cutoff_h) / 1.1) ** 2)
            gain = a_h * taper * (lpf + res_bump)
            sig += gain * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * h * idx / cyc)
    else:
        k_off = max(1, round(n_loop_cycles * (2.0 ** (detune_cents / 1200.0) - 1.0)))
        osc_cycles = [n_loop_cycles - k_off, n_loop_cycles, n_loop_cycles + k_off]
        osc_weights = [0.50, 0.95, 0.50]
        for oc, ow in zip(osc_cycles, osc_weights):
            freq_ratio = oc / float(n_lp)
            for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
                a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
                if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                    continue

**A Moment of Signal Processing Brilliance!**

Okay, so I was digging through the output and BAM! Right there at the bottom, I saw it: huge internal differences, single-sample jumps, and I immediately recognized a potential signal processing issue.

First, those additive synthesis instruments (`Bass_Octave`, `Bass_Acid303`, `Lead_HeroPWM`, `Stab_ChordChip`) were exhibiting massive one-sample drops at the half-cycle point (`idx = 64`). Turns out, that's the telltale sign of a sawtooth wave's Gibbs phenomenon – the *steep* discontinuous edge causing those huge sample differences. And that's happening because, when pitching those instruments up, the high harmonics were way over Nyquist and not being handled gracefully. So the fix? Apply a spectral rolloff like cosine or Lanczos filter to tame that Gibbs overshoot and use a 4ms fade-in, a good start value for `cutoff_h` around 14–16 harmonics, making it smooth even when pitched up.

Then, there was `Snare_Crisp`. A huge jump in a single sample! Looking deeper, it's the high-passed noise that's going wild. I was using a tanh on high-passed white noise with no band-limiting. This means that unconstrained white noise, even after high-passing, can still ping-pong between extremes at Nyquist – which sounds really harsh. So I need to add a gentle band-limit above, say, 12kHz, to the noise to smooth things out.

I also need to shift the spectral balance:
Low (<200 Hz): 40-48%
Mid (200-2500 Hz): 42-50%
Hi (>2500 Hz): 8-14%

To that end, dial back the sub-heavy `Kick` and `Bass`, and boost the presence of `Hat_Closed`, `Hat_Open`, `Snare_Crisp`, and `Lead_HeroPWM`!

And finally, it's time to nail down the stereo panning! After looking through the code for a while, I need to add `I_CNT` and `CH_CNT` (Inst 17) to make sure things are locked in where I want them. So I'm making a new counter-lead with the new panning and updating the stereo panning. From there, I need to make a couple of updates, for instance on `CH_ECHO1` to make sure it is in stereo correctly!

It's time to update and listen back!

import numpy as np

SR = 33452  # 8363 * 4 -> relative_note = 24 plays 1:1 at C-4 (261.34 Hz, 128 samples/cycle)
C4_HZ = SR / 128.0  # 261.34375 Hz

def remove_dc_and_taper(x, fade_in_ms=2.0, fade_out_ms=5.0, fade_out=True):
    x = x.astype(np.float64)
    x -= np.mean(x)
    n_in = min(len(x) // 4, int(SR * fade_in_ms / 1000.0))
    if n_in > 1:
        u = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_in)
        x[:n_in] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    if fade_out:
        n_out = min(len(x) // 2, int(SR * fade_out_ms / 1000.0))
        if n_out > 1:
            u = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, n_out)
            x[-n_out:] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    return x

def to_int16_pcm(x, peak=26000):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x))
    if m > 1e-12:
        x = x * (peak / m)
    return np.clip(np.round(x), -32767, 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes()

def one_pole_hp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = rc / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_x = 0.0
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        cur = alpha * (prev_y + x[i] - prev_x)
        y[i] = cur
        prev_x = x[i]
        prev_y = cur
    return y

def one_pole_lp(x, cutoff_hz):
    rc = 1.0 / (2.0 * np.pi * cutoff_hz)
    dt = 1.0 / SR
    alpha = dt / (rc + dt)
    y = np.zeros_like(x)
    prev_y = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x)):
        prev_y = prev_y + alpha * (x[i] - prev_y)
        y[i] = prev_y
    return y

def make_kick():
    # Punchy tight 180ms kick: 215 -> 52 Hz sweep + crisp attack transient
    dur = 0.18
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_start, f_end, tau_f = 215.0, 52.0, 0.024
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau_f * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau_f)))
    body = np.sin(phase) * 0.90 + 0.20 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.020)
    amp = np.exp(-t / 0.056)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
    click_noise = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 2000.0), 10000.0)
    click = (click_noise * 0.34 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1850 * t) * 0.42) * np.exp(-t / 0.0028)
    sig = np.tanh((body * amp + click) * 1.45)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 40.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=0.8, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Kick_Punch", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26000),
        "volume": 56, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_snare():
    # Crisp snappy snare: 230 -> 140 Hz body + sparkling bandlimited wires
    dur = 0.21
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (140.0 * t + 95.0 * 0.020 * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.020)))
    body = (np.sin(phase) + 0.28 * np.sin(1.85 * phase)) * np.exp(-t / 0.040)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(202)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 13500.0)
    wires_hi = one_pole_hp(noise, 1800.0)
    wires_snap = one_pole_hp(noise, 3800.0)
    wires = wires_hi * np.exp(-t / 0.068) * 0.86 + wires_snap * np.exp(-t / 0.024) * 0.78
    sig = np.tanh((body * 0.68 + wires * 0.96) * 1.32)
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 110.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=0.6, fade_out_ms=30.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Snare_Crisp", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 26500),
        "volume": 64, "panning": 122, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _metallic_hat(dur, decay_tau, seed):
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [317.0, 463.0, 619.0, 811.0, 1021.0, 1289.0]
    metal = np.zeros(n)
    for f in freqs:
        w = 2.0 * np.pi * f * t
        metal += np.sin(w) + 0.33 * np.sin(3 * w) + 0.2 * np.sin(5 * w)
    metal = one_pole_hp(metal / len(freqs), 4600.0)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    air = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 5800.0), 14000.0)
    sig = (metal * 0.68 + air * 1.05) * np.exp(-t / decay_tau)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=0.8, fade_out_ms=min(40.0, dur * 300.0), fade_out=True)
    return sig

def make_hat_closed():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.075, 0.020, 303)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Closed", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 24000),
        "volume": 60, "panning": 176, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_hat_open():
    sig = _metallic_hat(0.32, 0.098, 404)
    return {
        "name": "Hat_Open", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 24000),
        "volume": 56, "panning": 176, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_crash():
    dur = 0.92
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    rng = np.random.default_rng(505)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 13500.0)
    shimmer = one_pole_hp(noise, 3200.0)
    ring = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) for f in [523.0, 787.0, 1171.0, 1693.0, 2341.0]) / 5.0
    ring = one_pole_hp(ring, 2600.0)
    env = (1.0 - np.exp(-t / 0.004)) * np.exp(-t / 0.26)
    sig = (shimmer * 0.90 + ring * 0.35) * env
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=3.0, fade_out_ms=120.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Crash_Shimmer", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 23000),
        "volume": 52, "panning": 78, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_chip_tom():
    dur = 0.19
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_end = C4_HZ * 0.5
    f_start = f_end * 1.95
    tau = 0.032
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau)))
    body = np.sin(phase) + 0.18 * np.sin(2.0 * phase) - 0.10 * np.sin(3.0 * phase)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(606)
    snap = one_pole_lp(one_pole_hp(rng.standard_normal(n), 1500.0), 10000.0) * np.exp(-t / 0.006) * 0.35
    sig = body * np.exp(-t / 0.065) + snap
    sig = one_pole_hp(sig, 55.0)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=1.2, fade_out_ms=25.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "Chip_Tom", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 23000),
        "volume": 56, "panning": 78, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def _additive_sweep_loop(n_attack_cycles, n_loop_cycles, amp_fn, cutoff_fn, harm_amp_fn, res_fn=None, detune_cents=0.0, max_h=22):
    cyc = 128
    n_atk = n_attack_cycles * cyc
    n_lp = n_loop_cycles * cyc
    n_tot = n_atk + n_lp
    idx = np.arange(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)
    t_sec = idx / SR

    t_env = np.minimum(t_sec, n_atk / SR)
    amp_env = amp_fn(t_env)
    cutoff_h = cutoff_fn(t_env)
    res_amt = res_fn(t_env) if res_fn is not None else np.zeros_like(t_env)

    sig = np.zeros(n_tot, dtype=np.float64)

    if detune_cents == 0.0:
        for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
            a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
            if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                continue
            taper = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (h - 1) / float(max_h)) ** 0.55
            lpf = 1.0 / (1.0 + (h / np.maximum(cutoff_h, 1.0)) ** 4)
            res_bump = res_amt * np.exp(-0.5 * ((h - cutoff_h) / 1.1) ** 2)
            gain = a_h * taper * (lpf + res_bump)
            sig += gain * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * h * idx / cyc)
    else:
        k_off = max(1, round(n_loop_cycles * (2.0 ** (detune_cents / 1200.0) - 1.0)))
        osc_cycles = [n_loop_cycles - k_off, n_loop_cycles, n_loop_cycles + k_off]
        osc_weights = [0.50, 0.95, 0.50]
        for oc, ow in zip(osc_cycles, osc_weights):
            freq_ratio = oc / float(n_lp)
            for h in range(1, max_h + 1):
                a_h = harm_amp_fn(h)
                if abs(a_h) < 1e-6:
                    continue
                taper = np.cos(0.5 * np.pi * (h - 1) / float(max_h)) ** 0.55
                lpf = 1.0 / (1.0 + (h / np.maximum(cutoff_h, 1.0)) ** 4)
                sig += ow * a_h * taper * lpf * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * h * freq_ratio * idx)

    sig *= amp_env
    n_in = min(n_atk // 2, int(SR * 0.004))
    if n_in > 1:
        u = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_in)
        sig[:n_in] *= 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.pi * u))
    return sig, n_atk, n_lp

def make_bass_octave():
    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 36, 1

    return {

        "volume": 48, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,

    }

        "name": "Bass_Acid303", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22500),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

def _pulse_harm(duty):

    return fn

def make_chip_arp25():
    n_atk_c, n_lp_c = 16, 1

    return {

        "volume": 44, "panning": 192, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": n_atk, "loop_length": n_lp, "flags": 17
    }

def make_fx_laser():
    dur = 0.16
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f_start, f_end, tau = 1800.0, 130.0, 0.045
    phase = 2.0 * np.pi * (f_end * t + (f_start - f_end) * tau * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / tau)))
    sig = (np.sin(phase) + 0.30 * np.sin(3.0 * phase) * 0.5) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=2.0, fade_out_ms=20.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "FX_ChipLaser", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 22000),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

def make_fx_noise_riser():
    dur = 1.60
    n = int(SR * dur)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    rng = np.random.default_rng(707)
    noise = one_pole_lp(rng.standard_normal(n), 13000.0)
    y_bp = np.zeros(n)
    lp = 0.0
    bp = 0.0
    q_inv = 0.22
    u = t / dur
    cutoffs = 320.0 * (18.0 ** u)
    for i in range(n):
        f = 2.0 * np.sin(np.pi * min(cutoffs[i], SR * 0.42) / SR)
        hp = noise[i] - lp - q_inv * bp
        bp += f * hp
        lp += f * bp
        y_bp[i] = bp
    env = (u ** 1.7) * np.sin(np.pi * np.minimum(1.0, (1.0 - u) * 18.0) * 0.5)
    sig = y_bp * env
    sig = remove_dc_and_taper(sig, fade_in_ms=25.0, fade_out_ms=15.0, fade_out=True)
    return {
        "name": "FX_NoiseRiser", "pcm": to_int16_pcm(sig, 23000),
        "volume": 48, "panning": 128, "relative_note": 24, "finetune": 0,
        "loop_start": 0, "loop_length": 0, "flags": 16
    }

        make_hat_closed,      # 3  (pan=176 R)

        make_crash,           # 5  (pan=78 L)

        make_lead_pluck_bell, # 12 (pan=106 L-mid)
        make_pad_warm_chorus, # 13
        make_stab_chord_chip, # 14 (pan=192 R)
        make_fx_laser,        # 15
        make_fx_noise_riser,  # 16
        lambda: make_chip_pulse12(pan=48, name="Chip_Counter12", vol=46), # 17 (pan=48 L)
    ]
    return [(i + 1, fn()) for i, fn in enumerate(makers)]

{"command": "python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, wave, json, subprocess, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/keygen')
from compose_tune import build_tune, note_to_midi

g = build_tune()

# 1. Check active voices per pattern & channel usage
ch_counts = [0]*16
for (p, r, ch), c in g.cells.items():
    if 'note' in c and c['note'] != 97:
        ch_counts[ch] += 1
print("Active note-on counts per channel:", ch_counts)

# 2. Check for any unintended note collisions or out-of-range notes
notes_by_inst = {}
for (p, r, ch), c in g.cells.items():
    if 'note' in c and c['note'] != 97 and 'instrument' in c:
        notes_by_inst.setdefault(c['instrument'], []).append(c['note'])
for inst, ns in sorted(notes_by_inst.items()):
    print(f"Inst {inst:2d}: count={len(ns):4d}, min_note={min(ns):2d}, max_note={max(ns):2d}")

# 3. Check Stereo L/R RMS & Side/Mid across bands in preview.wav
with wave.open('/tmp/keygen/preview.wav', 'rb') as w:
    pa = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype='<i2').reshape(-1, 2).astype(float)
mid = 0.5 * (pa[:,0] + pa[:,1])
side = 0.5 * (pa[:,0] - pa[:,1])
fm = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(mid[44100*14:44100*42]))
fs = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(side[44100*14:44100*42]))
freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(44100*28, 1/44100)
print("\nStereo Side/Mid by frequency band (14s..42s):")
for f0, f1 in [(20, 200), (200, 1000), (1000, 5000), (5000, 15000)]:
    mask = (freqs >= f0) & (freqs < f1)
    em = np.sqrt(np.mean(fm[mask]**2))
    es = np.sqrt(np.mean(fs[mask]**2))
    print(f"  {f0:5d}-{f1:5d} Hz: Mid={em:9.1f}, Side={es:9.1f}, Side/Mid={es/max(em,1):.3f}")

# 4. Check silence / dropout windows (any 100ms window below RMS 300?)
hop = 4410
rms_100ms = [np.sqrt(np.mean(mid[i:i+hop]**2)) for i in range(0, len(mid)-hop, hop)]
print(f"\n100ms RMS min={min(rms_100ms):.1f} (at t={np.argmin(rms_100ms)*0.1:.1f}s), median={np.median(rms_100ms):.1f}, max={max(rms_100ms):.1f}")

# 5. Verify module_load roundtrip produces identical audio!
subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'module_load', json.dumps({'path': '/workspace/submission/tune.xm'})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
subprocess.run(['ft2', 'call', 'module_render', json.dumps({'path': '/tmp/keygen/reloaded.wav', 'rate': 44100, 'bits': 16})], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
with wave.open('/tmp/keygen/reloaded.wav', 'rb') as w:
    ra = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype='<i2').reshape(-1, 2).astype(float)
max_diff = np.max(np.abs(pa - ra))
print(f"XM roundtrip reload max sample diff: {max_diff:.1f}")
EOF"}
